summary: Built and validated the TLS Vault Transit provider and three-member integrated-Raft cluster. All four nodes survived serial machine reboots; Raft members automatically unsealed, retained data, and recovered as synchronized voters.
actions_performed: Installed Vault 2.1.0 and configured node-specific CA-signed TLS certificates.
Configured node1 with a persistent Transit key and automatic provider recovery.
Configured node2-node4 as a three-voter integrated-Raft cluster using Transit auto-unseal.
Enabled KV v2 at secret/ and stored proof=raft-auto-unseal at secret/infraset.
Created mode-0600 /root/vault-admin.env files on every Raft member.
Stopped the original leader, verified continued reads and writes, then restored it as a voter.
Restarted node1, node2, node4, and node3 serially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Validated TLS on all Vault nodes
evidence.summary: Each node certificate validates against the managed CA and contains its correct DNS and IP SAN.

evidence.requirement: Functional Transit seal provider on node1
evidence.summary: The non-exportable autounseal key and restricted policy exist; after reboot node1 was unsealed and completed a Transit encryption/decryption round trip.

evidence.requirement: Three-member Raft cluster with automatic Transit unseal
evidence.summary: Every Raft node is active, TLS-validated, storage_type=raft, seal type=transit, and logs current-boot stored-key unseal. Final Autopilot health is true with three synchronized voters.

evidence.requirement: KV v2 data and administrative environments
evidence.summary: secret/ is KV version 2, secret/infraset contains proof=raft-auto-unseal, and every Raft member has a working mode-0600 /root/vault-admin.env.

evidence.requirement: Availability with one member down and voter recovery
evidence.summary: With node2 inactive, node3 became leader and accepted a KV write while node4 served the new version. Restored node2 auto-unsealed, synchronized, and remained a voter.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered Transit service/data were observed.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, automatic unseal, retained KV data, and healthy voter recovery were observed.
Healthy leader baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, automatic unseal, leader failover, and voter recovery were observed.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, automatic unseal, retained KV data, and healthy voter recovery were observed.
